entries.title: Batched pull requests, forks and your crew's reach on Bitbucket Data Center
entries.body: A project on your own Bitbucket Data Center server can now choose batched pull requests. Your crew can read and change things in the project's own repository there, while a change anywhere else waits for your click. A project you cannot push to is offered through your fork. New comments on a crewmate's pull request wake it, and your open changes panel lists your Data Center pull requests. The server keeps no check logs, runs or release files, and your crew says so.

picture.alt: A Bitbucket Data Center project's settings, where Where changes go offers local merge, pull requests and batched pull requests.
